scope: Shop (between rounds): Blister, Workshop, choice steps, abandon purchase
validated_by: manual review against the game-ui-ux skill (its validator script and example are not bundled in this session)

player_decisions.shop: What to spend Pollen on, knowing the item and its price
player_decisions.pack_opening: Which one of three revealed options to keep (or skip)
player_decisions.seed_choice: Which seed(s) receive the tile upgrade (Forge, Sprout Pack, Blister sprout)

critical: why an item cannot be bought (tooltip + badge text)
decision_support: tooltip: name, effect, category/rarity (hover, focus or long-press)

input.pointer: hover shows tooltip; click buys; unaffordable click shakes (skipped with reduced motion)
input.keyboard_gamepad: first arrow/d-pad press while nothing is focused selects the first buyable item; Selectable navigation; focus halo + tooltip; Submit buys
input.touch: tap buys; long press (0.45 s) shows the tooltip without buying
input.back: Esc closes, in order: settings, seed bag, then arms/confirms abandoning a pending purchase; otherwise opens settings
input.abandon: 'Cancel purchase (no refund)' button, bottom right, two-step confirm; Skip on packs

layout.adaptive: item size 64-100 px and spacing 8-32 px computed from the room between the two tablets on every Refresh

localization: Shop and choice strings go through Loc.T (English table, Override hook); badges size to their text. Other screens still hard-coded.

accessibility.reduced_motion: Settings toggle (MotionSettings.Reduced): entrance pop, Pollen pulse, purchase pop, reroll flip, removal, hover swell, shake
not_color_only: unaffordable: faded icon + tooltip says how much Pollen is missing
accessibility.text_scale: follows CanvasScaler only; no separate user text-size setting

data_contract.source: RunManager (Core): ShopBlisterSlots, ShopUpgradeSlots, Pending*; presentation never mutates it except through RunManager methods
data_contract.update: full rebuild on ShopView.Refresh after each action
data_contract.hidden_data: none exposed (Forge payload is visible by design)

verification.done: headless Core tests (591 pass); code review
